<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
It seems my initial proposed slots didn't work. Brad has provided me with a list of times when Elena and David are available. My task is now to cross-reference this new list with the availability of Priya and Marcus to find a common slot for all four partners.

I need to go through each of the time slots Brad provided and check if both Priya and Marcus are free during that time. I will do this systematically, day by day. I have their calendar information from the previous session.

*   **Mon: 11:00, 11:30:** Priya is busy from 11:00-12:00. Marcus is free from 11:00-11:30 but busy from 11:30-12:00. So Monday is out.
*   **Tue: 09:00, 09:30:** Priya is busy from 09:00-10:30. Marcus is busy from 09:00-10:30. So Tuesday morning is out.
*   **Wed: 09:30, 13:00, 13:30, 16:00:** Priya is busy at 09:30. At 13:00, Priya is busy. At 13:30, Priya is busy. At 16:00, Priya is busy. So Wednesday is out.
*   **Thu: 09:30, 14:30, 15:00:** Priya is busy at 09:30. At 14:30, both Priya and Marcus are free. At 15:00, Marcus is busy. So Thursday at 14:30 works.
*   **Fri: 10:30, 14:30, 15:00, 15:30:** Priya is busy at 10:30. At 14:30, Priya is busy. At 15:00, Priya is busy. At 15:30, Priya is busy.

It looks like the only time that works for everyone is **Thursday at 14:30**.

My plan is to:
1.  Book the meeting for Thursday at 14:30.
2.  Inform Brad that I have booked the meeting and he can send the confirmation.
</SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
